source_current.Japanese:
あれ？　フリオさん
どこに行ったんだろう？
source_current.current_English: Where did Julio go?

source_current.Japanese: おーい、ここじゃここじゃ
source_current.current_English: Over here!

source_current.Japanese: あ、交易所か…
source_current.current_English: Oh, he's at the Market...

source_current.Japanese:
手始めに、ここで交易品を売って
みるのじゃ。リスボンで買ったものが
あるんじゃったら
売ってみてもよい。ただし…
source_current.current_English:
Start by selling some trade goods
 here. If you have anything you 
 bought in Lisbon, try selling that.
 But remember...

source_current.Japanese:
売るためには
そう、『契約』が必要じゃ
source_current.current_English: You need a contract to sell goods.

source_current.Japanese: 契約…ですか？
source_current.current_English: A contract?

source_current.Japanese:
王宮や総督府に行って
その街を治めとる領主に契約金を渡して
交易する権利をもらうのじゃ
source_current.current_English:
At the Palace or Governor's Office,
 pay the local ruler a contract fee 
 for the right to trade in town.

source_current.Japanese:
とにかくいろんな街で契約しておくと
よいぞ。まあ、初めのうちなら
契約金額は最低で構わんじゃろう
source_current.current_English:
Get contracts in different towns.
 The minimum fee should be enough 
 at first.

source_current.Japanese:
セウタとの契約はわしがやっておいたが
次からはおまえさんがやるのじゃ
source_current.current_English:
I arranged the contract in Ceuta.
 You'll handle the others yourself.

source_current.Japanese:
セウタにおいて
FOのシェアは
２０％となっています
シェアに応じて交易の取引ができます
source_current.current_English:
FO's market share in Ceuta 
 is 20 percent. Your share
 determines how much
 of the local stock you can buy.

source_current.Japanese:
よし、売りたいものがあれば
売ってしまえい
source_current.current_English:
All right. If you have anything
 you want to sell, go ahead.

source_current.Japanese:
はい
そうします
source_current.current_English: All right.

source_current.Japanese:
FI、ここまでは
順調かな？　分かりにくいかもしれん
から航路の説明をしようと思うんじゃが
よいかな？
source_current.current_English:
Is everything going smoothly 
 so far, FI? Sea routes 
 can be confusing. Shall I explain
 how they work?

source_current.Japanese:
うむ。近くで隣り合っている
街や港と契約すれば、それで航路が
引かれたことになるんじゃ
source_current.current_English:
Contracts with neighboring towns 
 or ports create a sea route.

source_current.Japanese:
たとえば、今
FOが契約した街に
リスボンとセウタがある
source_current.current_English:
For example, FO
 has agreements with Lisbon 
 and Ceuta.

source_current.Japanese:
この二つの街は隣合っとるので
『FOは、この間に
　航路を持つ』
ということになる
source_current.current_English:
FO has a sea route between 
 neighboring Lisbon and Ceuta.

source_current.Japanese:
甲板画面で、『艦長』と『測量士』が
いる状態で、航路があれば
『自動移動』ができるようになる
source_current.current_English:
With a Captain and Surveyor
 assigned on the Deck screen, 
 you can use Auto Move along
 an established route.

source_current.Japanese: 『自動移動』？
source_current.current_English: Auto Move?

source_current.Japanese:
航路さえつながっておれば、いちいち
操船を命令しなくてもよい。目的地さえ
決めてくれれば、わしら航海士が
勝手に操作して移動する
source_current.current_English:
Choose a destination on a connected
 route. We navigators will handle 
 the ship.

source_current.Japanese:
出港所で『自動移動』を選んで
航路図から目的地を指定するんじゃ
source_current.current_English:
At the port, choose Auto Move, 
 then select your destination on
 the Route Map.

source_current.Japanese: ただ…
source_current.current_English: But...

source_current.Japanese:
この艦隊には測量士になれる者が
おらんのう…
source_current.current_English: No one here can serve as surveyor...

source_current.Japanese:
じいさん
偉そうなことばっか言って
測量くらいできねえのかよ
source_current.current_English:
All that big talk, and you can't 
 even survey, old man?

source_current.Japanese:
…しょうがあるまいのう
リスボンまで行って、六分儀を買って
おくれ。それさえあれば、わしが何とか
してやろう
source_current.current_English:
...Very well. Go to Lisbon and buy 
 a sextant. With that, I'll find
 a way to manage.

source_current.Japanese:
ちゃんとわしに『装備』させるのを
忘れるでないぞ
source_current.current_English: Do not forget to equip me with it.

source_current.Japanese: 装備？
source_current.current_English: Equip?

source_current.Japanese:
買ったアイテムをよく調べれば分かる
わい。とにかくリスボンに向かうのじゃ
source_current.current_English:
Examine the item and you will see. 
 Now head to Lisbon.

source_current.Japanese: は、はい
source_current.current_English: Y-yes.

source_records.Japanese: 大丈夫です。分かります

小売店の看板を選ぶと
流行などの情報を聞けます
town_and_sea_shared_requests.current_English:
Choose a shop sign to ask about
 trends and other local news.
town_and_sea_shared_requests.human_read_gameplay_text: Choose a shop sign to ask about trends and other local news.

town_and_sea_shared_requests.original_Japanese:
あなた、船乗りでしょう？
大口の商売なら
交易所に行くといいですよ
town_and_sea_shared_requests.current_English:
You're a sailor, aren't you?
  Try the Market for bulk trade.
town_and_sea_shared_requests.human_read_gameplay_text: You're a sailor, aren't you? Try the Market for bulk trade.
town_and_sea_shared_requests.speaker: Shopkeeper

town_and_sea_shared_requests.original_Japanese:
景気？　まあ、ぼちぼちですね
何か、うまい話はないもんかねえ
town_and_sea_shared_requests.current_English:
Business? Oh, it's been all right.
  I'm hoping a good deal comes along.
town_and_sea_shared_requests.human_read_gameplay_text: Business? Oh, it's been all right. I'm hoping a good deal comes along.
town_and_sea_shared_requests.speaker: Shopkeeper

town_and_sea_shared_requests.original_Japanese: あんた、積み荷は何もないだろ
town_and_sea_shared_requests.speaker: Port Worker
